illustration.description: Flat cartoon-style illustration with thick dark outlines and soft cel shading. A woman with shoulder-length brown hair and closed, smiling eyes is mid-yawn with her mouth wide open. Both arms are raised overhead with clenched fists in a full body stretch. She wears a light blue short-sleeve t-shirt with a subtle fabric texture and dark navy pants. A tall vertical blue measuring ruler with tick marks stands to her left. Three small golden-yellow four-point sparkle stars float around her head and arms. Clean white background, no text.

texts.text: YOU STRETCH LIKE YOU JUST WOKE UP
